574-5702-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, either creating a 1/1 green Insect creature token or causing you to pay {1}{G} and create a copy of the creature enchanted by Springheart Nantuko
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-5702-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2645-3430-4644-5233.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4644-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

512-4137-5475.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-4137-5475.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-4699.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-4716.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

851-4365-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

457-1458-3497-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-3497-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3861-3875-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3861-3875-4231-4365.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-2034-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-5722-7296.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-7296.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

2730-4050-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
2730-4050-7206.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dundoolin Weaver, adding {B}.
When Dundoolin Weaver dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dundoolin Weaver enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Dundoolin Weaver.
Repeat.

3028-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3028-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2930-4222-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Portent Tracker.
Repeat.

3944-5220-5933-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3518-4195-4574-5741.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

573-1479-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-6662.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1690-2364-2538-4908.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
1690-2364-2538-4908.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2364-2538-4908.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

147-2438-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2511-4558-5913.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-2511-4558-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

1636-2366-3346-4452-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
"Mercenary" chosen with Rukarumel.
1636-2366-3346-4452-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1047-1283-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Mobile Garrison is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Mobile Garrison.
1047-1283-3750.description:
Declare Mobile Garrison as an attacker.
Mobile Garrison triggers, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

3398-3851-4813.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Famished Foragers.
Famished Foragers does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Famished Foragers and Hellkite Charger.
 An opponent has lost life this turn.
3398-3851-4813.description:
Declare Famished Foragers as an attacker.
Hellkite Charger and Famished Foragers' myriad ability trigger.
Resolve the Famished Foragers trigger, creating at least three token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Famished Foragers tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least nine {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Famished Foragers tokens.
Repeat each combat phase.

1283-1999-4404-5129.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1999-4404-5129.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {1}, tapping it and returning Corridor Monitor to your hand, putting Corridor Monitor from your hand onto the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Mirrorworks.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {1}, tapping it and returning Chromatic Orrery to your hand, putting Chromatic Orrery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Chromatic Orrery enters the battlefield, triggering Mirrorworks; choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger from step 3, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

2816-3430-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Incubation Druid.
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2816-3430-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color a land you control could produce.
Activate Incubation Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

91-3693-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, gaining Mairsil undying.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil undying triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter.
Activate Mairsil using Walking Ballista's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

643-4050-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4050-4302.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.
